applicant.name: Dr. Anna Poelzl
applicant.organisation: Styrian Public Health Institute (public health institute)

purpose: We follow adults with obesity over several years to see how BMI develops after new diagnoses and the start of weight-related medicines. For that we need each person's repeated BMI values linked to their own condition and medication history.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications and BMI values for adults with obesity who have at least one BMI value.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Obesity = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E66.
Cohort = adults with obesity who have at least one BMI value (LOINC 39156-5).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.

expected.reason: The purpose is allowed (Art. 53). The applicant has shown that anonymised data cannot achieve it, so pseudonymised data is justified (Art. 66(3)). Access only under a data permit (Art. 68) inside a secure processing environment; only non-personal data may leave it (Art. 73(2)).

judge.why: Rule 4: the application follows adults over several years using each person's repeated BMI values linked to their own history, which statistics cannot do, and the Report line is a cohort size, not a per-group statistic.
